name: comp-429
title: Underline Tabs
blurb: Tabs with underline active indicator on transparent background.
description: Minimalist tab variant with underline indicator using pseudo-elements. Transparent background, bottom border separator.
use_when: Clean, minimal interfaces requiring subtle tab indicators.
avoid_when: When you need tabs with background colors or more distinct button styling.
a11y: Semantic tabs with keyboard navigation via radix-ui Tabs component.
